cards.example_en: A schoolboy ran across the playground with a football under his arm.
cards.example_zh: 一个男生腋下夹着足球跑过操场。

cards.example_en: The schoolgirl practised the piano for an hour after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 这个女生晚饭后练了一小时钢琴。

cards.example_en: Do not scold the child in front of his friends.
cards.example_zh: 不要当着孩子朋友的面责骂他。

cards.example_en: She picked up a pink seashell and held it gently to her ear.
cards.example_zh: 她捡起一枚粉色的海贝壳，轻轻贴在耳边。

cards.example_en: Dark seaweed covered the rocks after the tide went out.
cards.example_zh: 退潮之后，深色的海藻覆盖在岩石上。

cards.example_en: Keeping the last piece of cake for himself seemed selfish.
cards.example_zh: 把最后一块蛋糕留给自己，显得很自私。

cards.example_en: The children sat in a semicircle and listened to the story.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们坐成半圆听故事。

cards.example_en: The history seminar begins at four in room twelve.
cards.example_zh: 历史研讨会四点在十二号教室开始。

cards.example_en: A long separation from his family made the sailor deeply lonely.
cards.example_zh: 与家人的长期分离让这位水手深感孤独。

cards.example_en: His shabby coat had worn holes at both elbows.
cards.example_zh: 他那件破旧外套的两个肘部都磨出了洞。

cards.example_en: Impatience is her main shortcoming as a team leader.
cards.example_zh: 缺乏耐心是她作为团队负责人的主要缺点。

cards.example_en: Wool sweaters may shrink if you wash them in very hot water.
cards.example_zh: 羊毛衫如果用很热的水洗，可能会缩水。

cards.example_en: We turned onto a quiet side road to avoid the traffic.
cards.example_zh: 我们拐上一条安静的支路，好避开堵车。

cards.example_en: Ice on the sidewalk made the walk to school dangerous.
cards.example_zh: 人行道上的冰让步行上学变得危险。

cards.example_en: The truck slid sideways on the icy road and hit the fence.
cards.example_zh: 卡车在结冰的路上向一侧滑去，撞上了围栏。

cards.example_en: He would sigh whenever the bus arrived late again.
cards.example_zh: 每当公共汽车又晚点时，他就会叹气。

cards.example_en: We spent the whole morning sightseeing around the old town.
cards.example_zh: 我们整个上午都在老城区观光。

cards.example_en: Few people understood the significance of that discovery at first.
cards.example_zh: 起初很少有人理解那项发现的意义。

cards.example_en: Can you simplify these instructions so beginners can follow them easily?
cards.example_zh: 你能把这些说明简化一下，好让初学者容易照做吗？

cards.example_en: A skilful cook can turn simple ingredients into a fine meal.
cards.example_zh: 熟练的厨师能把简单的食材做成一顿美餐。

cards.example_en: A glass skyscraper rose high above the older buildings downtown.
cards.example_zh: 一座玻璃摩天大楼高高耸立在市中心较老的建筑之上。

cards.example_en: The novel describes the hard life of a slave on a cotton farm.
cards.example_zh: 这部小说描写了一个奴隶在棉花农场的艰苦生活。

cards.example_en: Historians say slavery was abolished there during the nineteenth century.
cards.example_zh: 历史学家说，那里的奴隶制在十九世纪被废除。

cards.example_en: She rolled up one sleeve before she started washing the dishes.
cards.example_zh: 她开始洗碗之前先卷起了一只袖子。

cards.example_en: A slight delay made us late for the first lesson.
cards.example_zh: 稍有耽搁，我们就第一节课迟到了。

cards.example_en: His left sneaker came untied halfway through the long race.
cards.example_zh: 长跑进行到一半时，他左脚运动鞋的鞋带松了。

cards.example_en: The little boy began to sob when his red balloon flew away.
cards.example_zh: 小男孩的红气球飞走时，他开始抽泣。

cards.example_en: The lamp will not light unless you plug it into the wall socket.
cards.example_zh: 除非把插头插进墙上的插座，否则这盏灯不会亮。

cards.example_en: I bought a small souvenir for my grandmother at the night market.
cards.example_zh: 我在夜市给祖母买了一件小纪念品。

cards.example_en: A sparrow hopped along the wooden fence, looking for crumbs.
cards.example_zh: 一只麻雀沿着木篱笆跳着找面包屑。

cards.example_en: Hunters once used a long wooden spear to catch fish in shallow rivers.
cards.example_zh: 猎人们曾经用长木矛在浅河里捕鱼。

cards.example_en: Watch the wooden top spin until it slowly falls onto its side.
cards.example_zh: 看这个木陀螺旋转，直到它慢慢侧倒。

cards.example_en: The temple visit gave her a spiritual feeling of peace.
cards.example_zh: 参观寺庙给了她一种精神上的平静。

cards.example_en: We can split the sandwich if you are still hungry.
cards.example_zh: 如果你还饿，我们可以把三明治分开吃。

cards.example_en: During the briefing, the spokesman denied any link to the rumor.
cards.example_zh: 在情况通报会上，发言人否认与该传言有任何关联。

cards.example_en: A spokeswoman for the hospital said the injured patient was recovering.
cards.example_zh: 医院的一位女发言人说，受伤的病人正在康复。

cards.example_en: Gardeners spray the roses early in the morning to keep insects away.
cards.example_zh: 园丁一清早给玫瑰喷药，以防虫害。

cards.example_en: You should squeeze fresh lemon juice over the fish before serving it.
cards.example_zh: 上菜之前，你应该把新鲜柠檬汁挤在鱼上。

cards.example_en: A squirrel raced up the oak tree with a nut held in its mouth.
cards.example_zh: 一只松鼠嘴里叼着坚果，飞快地爬上了橡树。

cards.example_en: The ladder felt stable when Dad climbed onto the roof.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸爬上屋顶时，梯子感觉很稳。

cards.example_en: Coffee left a dark stain on the white tablecloth.
cards.example_zh: 咖啡在白色桌布上留下了一块深色污渍。

cards.example_en: This stainless steel knife will not rust in the dishwasher.
cards.example_zh: 这把不锈钢刀放在洗碗机里也不会生锈。

cards.example_en: The charity works hard to prevent starvation after a major flood.
cards.example_zh: 这家慈善机构在大洪水之后努力防止人们挨饿。

cards.example_en: The respected statesman urged both sides to return to peace talks.
cards.example_zh: 这位德高望重的政治家敦促双方回到和谈上来。

cards.example_en: As a stateswoman, she argued for fair laws and open public debate.
cards.example_zh: 作为女政治家，她力争公平的法律和公开的辩论。

cards.example_en: The train steward showed us to our seats and offered tea.
cards.example_zh: 火车上的男乘务员把我们领到座位，并送来了茶。

cards.example_en: A stewardess offered warm blankets to passengers on the night flight.
cards.example_zh: 一位女乘务员给夜航班机上的乘客递上了暖和的毯子。

cards.example_en: Winter coats stay in storage until the weather turns.
cards.example_zh: 冬天的外套先存放着，等到天气转冷再拿出来。

cards.example_en: A stout wooden door kept the cold wind out of the cottage.
cards.example_zh: 一扇结实的木门把寒风挡在了小屋外面。

cards.example_en: She set the kettle on the stove and waited for the water to boil.
cards.example_zh: 她把水壶放在炉子上，等着水烧开。
